Name: 101 cupola
Description: Cupolas are a sophisticated architectural feature often used in high-end homes to add both elegance and functionality to the roofline. These structures, typically perched at the highest point of the roof, are designed to enhance the homes exterior by introducing a timeless and refined element of design. Cupolas can be crafted in various shapes, including square, round, or octagonal, and are made from premium materials such as copper, lead-coated copper, freedom gray copper, zinc, or aluminum

Name: 301 finial
Description: Originally crafted to solve water seepage issues on round roofs, finials have evolved into stunning decorative features, gracing iconic architectural styles from Gothic to Renaissance. At SMW, we take it a step further by offering customizable finials that not only enhance your structure’s visual appeal but also incorporate lightning protection systems for added safety. Trust in centuries of design influence with modern-day innovation.

Name: 400 dormer
Description: Dormers are architectural features that extend vertically from a sloped roof, usually housing a window or vent, and are clad in copper or other durable metals. Dormers add functional space to the upper levels of a building, often increasing natural light and ventilation in attics or top-floor rooms. Copper dormers, specifically, stand out due to their unique aesthetic appeal and practical benefits. Zinc and copper dormers combine beauty, durability, and sustainability, making them a valuable addition to both traditional and modern architecture.

The exhaust vent is found near the ridge of the roof and is sometimes integrated into the roof system on top of the ridge.
